title: RSNA Knee OmniRad-base U9 A30 Bundle
subtitle: Private offline bundle: OmniRad-base u9, lateral oversample + noise, 30 epochs
description: Inference-only bundle for the RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection competition: run r4a-k8-omnirad-base-soft-336-u9-b1-lat-os-noise-ep30 (OmniRad-base ViT-B/14, last 9 blocks fine-tuned on soft LM label values at 336 px, K=8 3-slice windows per plane, masked mean pooling; lateral-label oversampling and label noise during training, 30 epochs), offline inference code, and vendored DICOM codec wheels. Contains no competition images, reports, labels, or study identifiers.
